evals.prompt: Convert this iPhone .qta spatial audio recording into a normal m4a I can share.
evals.expected_output: Probe with both afinfo and ffprobe, stream-copy Track 0 (stereo AAC) with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c:a copy to a .m4a beside the source without removing the source, and verify with afinfo.
assertions: Probes with both afinfo and ffprobe first
Uses stream copy (-map 0:a:0 -c:a copy) for the stereo AAC track
Leaves the source file in place and verifies the output with afinfo

evals.prompt: Extract the 4-channel APAC ambisonic track from recording.qta as a 24-bit WAV for Reaper.
evals.expected_output: Probe first, decode Track 1 with afconvert --read-track 1 -f WAVE -d LEI24 because ffmpeg cannot decode APAC, verify with afinfo, and note that the resulting WAV carries ACN/SN3D ambisonics without a channel-layout tag.
assertions: Uses afconvert --read-track 1 -f WAVE -d LEI24 instead of ffmpeg for APAC
Warns that the WAV has no channel-layout tag and the channels are ACN/SN3D ambisonics
Verifies output codec, channel count, and duration with afinfo

evals.prompt: Pull the audio track out of demo.mov as an MP3.
evals.expected_output: Probe demo.mov with afinfo and ffprobe, re-encode the audio stream with ffmpeg -map 0:a:0 -c:a libmp3lame -q:a 2 beside the source, and verify with afinfo.
assertions: Triggers audio-convert for extracting audio from video
Maps the audio stream explicitly with -map 0:a:0
Re-encodes to MP3 and verifies output with afinfo

evals.prompt: Transcribe this interview.m4a into a text transcript with speaker labels.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger audio-convert; route to a speech-to-text or transcription workflow.
assertions: Does not trigger audio-convert for transcription
Does not run ffmpeg or afconvert format conversion unless transcription requires a format change

evals.prompt: Re-encode this 4K ProRes video to 1080p H.264 MP4.
evals.expected_output: Do not trigger audio-convert; video transcoding is outside this skill's scope.
assertions: Does not trigger audio-convert for video transcoding
